definitions.explanation: A thing or object, especially something for sale.
The degree of excellence or refinement.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{品|しな}が{豊富|ほうふ}だ。
examples.english: This store has a rich variety of goods.

examples.japanese: このお{店|みせ}の{品|しな}は{質|しつ}が{高|たか}くて{値段|ねだん}も{手頃|てごろ}だ。{何度|なんど}も{通|かよ}ってしまう。
examples.english: The goods at this shop are high quality and reasonably priced. I find myself coming back again and again.

notes:
{品|しな} has two main meanings: physical goods/items, and quality/refinement.

MEANING 1 - GOODS/ITEMS:
- {品|しな}が{揃|そろ}う (goods are available)
- {品|しな}を{揃|そろ}える (to stock items)
- {品|しな}{切|ぎ}れ (out of stock)

MEANING 2 - QUALITY/REFINEMENT:
- {品|しな}が{良|よ}い / {品|しな}がある (refined, elegant)
- {品|しな}が{悪|わる}い / {品|しな}がない (vulgar, unrefined)

RELATED TERMS:
- {品物|しなもの} (goods, articles - emphasizes physical items)
- {商品|しょうひん} (product, merchandise)
- {上品|じょうひん} (elegant, refined)
- {下品|げひん} (vulgar, coarse)

COUNTER: {品|ひん}/{点|てん} for counting items
